{"assessments":[{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选从胸口过度用力切入，解释气流、声带振动与漏气之间的关系，并给出力度应适中的结论；核心教学链条清楚，但个别术语受转写影响。","candidate_id":"candidate_a0f21643888730a5","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"唱歌时胸口发紧和漏气可能与胸口过度用力、气流压力失衡有关。","risk_summary":"包含关于发声器官、气流压力及漏气成因的生理性解释，且个别术语转写不清。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"胸口发紧与唱歌漏气的原因","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选包含舌头和口腔空间的技巧观点，但大量篇幅用于欢迎观众、索赞和连麦说明，开头所指的具体动作还依赖前文。","candidate_id":"candidate_34558c9f504eca45","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["context_dependency"],"primary_claim":"唱歌时不应刻意挤压舌头，舌头与上颚之间更大的空间有助于高音演唱。","risk_summary":"开头动作的指代依赖前文，且候选夹有明显的直播互动和引流内容。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"舌头位置、口腔空间与高音","uncertainty_flags":["missing_context","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"后半段能够辨认出对咬字位置、舌头和腰腹支撑的具体诊断，但开头转写严重混乱，判断还部分依赖未提供的演唱表现。","candidate_id":"candidate_22d3260a7179c022","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"这次演唱的问题包括咬字位置过于靠后、舌头处理不当，以及腰腹支撑不足。","risk_summary":"开头转写混乱，且对演唱问题的诊断部分依赖未提供的现场表现。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"咬字位置与腰腹支撑诊断","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选明确提出从真声、咬字通道到高音和假声的渐进训练顺序，并用漏气现象说明基础配合的重要性；多处声乐术语存在同音误转。","candidate_id":"candidate_005f7d0822d40234","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"流行演唱训练应先建立真声和咬字通道，再逐步过渡到高音及假声，否则容易出现漏气等问题。","risk_summary":"多个关键声乐术语可能被同音误转，影响表述精确度。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"流行演唱技巧的渐进训练顺序","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选前部谈年龄与嗓音机能，后部转为连麦、课程价值和个人求学经历，能够形成关于学习投入的表达，但主题跳转较多且首句逻辑不够清楚。","candidate_id":"candidate_a4bef74f0779a1e2","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"年龄可能影响嗓音机能，而专业指导具有较高学习成本，因此直播中的免费交流机会值得把握。","risk_summary":"包含未经展开的年龄与嗓音机能判断，也带有课程价值和连麦机会的推广表达。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"年龄、嗓音机能与声乐学习投入","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics","claim_ambiguity","asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选在直播互动内容之外，较完整地说明了舌头下凹、打开内口腔和高音通道之间的教学关系，观点容易提取但论证较简略。","candidate_id":"candidate_8cae2aab5bc153ac","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"气息和嘴形正确时舌头会自然下凹，而打开内口腔有助于建立高音通道。","risk_summary":"包含关于口腔与高音发声关系的身体技巧主张，并夹有粉丝牌、点赞和连麦推广。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"打开内口腔与高音通道","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选列出多种发声类型，并强调气息培养和从真声到高音的训练步骤，具有明确教学价值；若干核心术语被转写成不准确的同音字。","candidate_id":"candidate_2716045703db1f3b","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"流行唱法技巧虽多，但训练应重视气息基础，并从真声和咬字通道逐步过渡到高音。","risk_summary":"关键声乐术语存在转写歧义，同时以学员进步速度为自身教学方法背书。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"气息基础与流行唱法训练步骤","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选以婴儿和青春期为例讨论声带变化，清楚提出男生和女生变声期存在差异；结尾提出变声后音色变化的问题，但答案留在候选之外。","candidate_id":"candidate_7c52ff6875a16a62","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"声音机能会随成长和变声期发生变化，男生与女生进入变声期的时间和变化程度可能不同。","risk_summary":"包含关于声带发育和变声期的生理性判断，且结尾问题未在候选内得到解释。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"成长与变声期对声音的影响","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选能够提取出先放松舌头、再让正确气息和嘴形带动舌头自然下凹的观点，但前部转写不稳，中段又插入较长的直播推广。","candidate_id":"candidate_1261f4ebdaaa4ed6","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"唱高音时不宜刻意控制舌头，应先保持舌头放松，并通过正确气息和嘴形让其自然下凹。","risk_summary":"舌头状态的部分描述转写不清，同时包含身体技巧主张和连麦推广内容。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"高音演唱中的舌头放松","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选后半段形成了鲜明且完整的观点：修音可以修正或美化音高，却不能替代歌唱者自身的发声通道和共鸣；开头试音部分略显混乱。","candidate_id":"candidate_e27d41447dbfb889","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"音响或后期修音只能美化和修正声音，不能替代歌唱者自身的发声通道与共鸣。","risk_summary":"开头试音和场景描述存在少量转写混乱。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"修音无法替代发声通道和共鸣","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选主要用零基础学员数量、短期见效和绝对成功率来证明教学效果，核心营销主张可辨认，但开头语句破损且缺乏候选内证据支持。","candidate_id":"candidate_2a81f27ea2fccc4f","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"讲述者声称其大量零基础学员能够在很短时间内见效，并以此证明教学成效。","risk_summary":"包含缺少候选内佐证的短期见效和绝对成功率宣传，部分表述也存在转写歧义。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"零基础声乐教学效果宣传","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选混合了音频反馈引流、嗓子疲劳处理、腹部练习和学员展示等内容；可辨认出关于嗓子状态的建议，但缺乏完整解释且主题十分分散。","candidate_id":"candidate_ec801fd85b29d485","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"候选认可通过发气发音来缓解嗓子哑和嗓子累的说法，同时推广音频反馈和教学服务。","risk_summary":"包含未经说明的嗓音不适处理建议以及教学服务引流，相关主张没有完整展开。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"嗓音疲劳建议与教学服务推广","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选是一段可理解的直播开场，说明直播间提供声乐教学、问题互动和连麦，但几乎没有独立的知识观点，且有少量重复和转写杂音。","candidate_id":"candidate_7f4a5d4251808e1e","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"该直播间提供声乐教学，并邀请观众提交音乐问题或参与连麦。","risk_summary":"内容主要是直播间介绍和互动推广，且部分重复语句转写不稳。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"声乐教学直播间开场介绍","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选说明将讨论音乐初学者常见的高音卡顿和破音问题，但尚未给出原因或解决办法；其余部分主要是欢迎观众和连麦安排。","candidate_id":"candidate_f0c88f3966f4c86b","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"讲述者准备讲解音乐初学者常见的高音卡顿和破音问题。","risk_summary":"内容带有粉丝牌和连麦推广，且对初学者问题只完成了引题、没有展开解答。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"初学者常见的高音问题预告","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选以天赋和努力的对照形成直接观点，并明确区分职业出道与个人爱好，能够独立传达鼓励学习的信息；末段转向方言和说话位置，稍显离题。","candidate_id":"candidate_260b8f35571eae11","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"天赋会限制职业发展的基础条件，但技术和努力仍能提升演唱水平，作为爱好学习唱歌不受年龄限制。","risk_summary":"包含关于嗓音条件、年龄和职业可能性的概括性身体与能力判断。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"天赋、努力与不同年龄学习唱歌","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"}]}
